events.description: Woman says Woman is coming through the laundromat aisle.
Woman says the other people in the laundromat should move out of Woman's way right now.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking Woman to excuse Rachel Green.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green was using the washing machine that Woman took.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green saved the washing machine by putting Rachel Green's basket on top of the washing machine.
Woman says Woman is sorry.
Woman says the basket on top of the washing machine is Rachel Green's basket.
Woman says Rachel Green's basket is really pretty.
Woman says Woman does not see soap suds in the washing machine.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is asking what is going on with the washing machine situation.
Rachel Green says Woman took the washing machine that Rachel Green intended to use.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is asking whether Rachel Green's basket was on top of the washing machine.
Rachel Green says there were no suds in the washing machine.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is asking Woman to hold on a second.
Ross Geller says the washing machine Woman is using is Rachel Green's washing machine.
Woman says Rachel Green's laundry was not in the washing machine.
Ross Geller says the "no suds, no save" claim is not the rule at the laundromat and says Woman knows that.
Ross Geller says the confrontation in the laundromat is over.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Rachel Green are going to do laundry now.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller's intervention to reclaim the washing machine for Rachel Green was amazing.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green cannot even send back soup at a restaurant.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green needs detergent.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking what the detergent is.
Ross Geller says the detergent named Uberveiss is new, German, and extra-tough.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is asking whether Rachel Green is going to separate the laundry items into different loads.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking whether Rachel Green is being a total laundry spaz.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking whether Rachel Green should use one washing machine for shirts and another washing machine for pants.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is asking whether Rachel Green has ever done laundry before.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green knows other people who have done laundry themselves before.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller caught Rachel Green about not having done laundry before.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green has never done laundry before.
Ross Geller says Rachel Green should not worry.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller will use the gentle cycle.

Ross Geller says Rachel Green should use one washing machine for all of Rachel Green's whites, another washing machine for colors, and a third washing machine for Rachel Green's delicates, which are Rachel Green's bras and underpants.
Rachel Green says the panties Rachel Green is holding are white cotton panties.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is asking whether the white cotton panties should go with the whites load or with the delicates load.
Ross Geller says deciding whether the white cotton panties go with the whites load or the delicates load is a judgment call.
